posts.description: It’s kind of stunning that in the year 2026 I still see people using plays on the “got milk?” ad campaign in their own promotions, some 30 years after its heyday.

Finished watching: Wildwood 🎥 Absolutely gorgeous and impressive visually. Yes, several beats of the story could be dinged as derivative (as could most? all? children’s fantasy post-Lewis/Le Guin/Tolkien), but it was absorbing throughout and the debt it owes to the works that came before didn’t lessen it, in my eyes. I found it very moving to watch a film that was 16 years in the making, in a pack
Oh, just watching old videos of Clyde Davenport fiddling on his porch at 0.25x speed to figure out his bowing . . . Why; how are you spending your Saturday evening?
